# descope_email_template (Resource)

Manages a single email message template for an authentication method in a Descope project. The active template is selected on the method's settings resource, e.g. the `email_template_id` attribute of `descope_magiclink_settings`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `method` (String) The authentication method the email template is used with, e.g. `magiclink` or `otp`. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `name` (String) A name for the email template that's unique among the templates of the same authentication method.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that the email template belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `subject` (String) The subject line of emails sent with this template.

### Optional

- `html_body` (String) The HTML body of emails sent with this template. Required unless `use_plain_text_body` is enabled. Template macros such as `{{.code}}` can be used to insert dynamic values.
- `plain_text_body` (String) The plain text body of emails sent with this template. Required when `use_plain_text_body` is enabled.
- `use_plain_text_body` (Boolean) Whether emails are sent with the plain text body instead of the HTML body.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
